name: SigmasFunction (including plain cosine)
plain: One node with a menu of unit-range curves. It's where the simplest cosine and exponential ramps live, plus Gaussian, polynomial fit of points, custom expressions and a Qwen Image 2.1 option.
math:
exponential: linspace(1,0,n+1)^p. cosine: cos(linspace(0,π/2,n+1)). gauss: x∈[0,p], (G(x)−G(p))/(1−G(p)), G=e^{−x²} per label.
Also polynomial, polygon, custom, manual, qwen21; each scaled by scale.

props.params: function, steps, p, scale, points, custom_function, x_from, x_to, clip

label: from code
